notes: Variant WLC.JOS.3.4.v001 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base; its qere fallback remains among the readings the English permits, so rule 53 does not apply and s006-s008 are aligned as ordinary source text.
The first `בֵּין` and its waw are rendered *between ... and*; the repeated second `בֵּין` is the unrepresented occurrence (rule 26).
`מִתְּמוֹל שִׁלְשׁוֹם` → *heretofore* is retained as one noncompositional unit: the single English word writes no morpheme's own lexeme, so rule 6's first-token anchor governs the source head.
`אַל־תִּקְרְבוּ` → *come not near* is headed on *come* under rule 44's phrasal-particle clause; heading on *near* as the lexeme-bearing complement is the available alternative.
